statements.impact_statement: The defect is OpenSSL QUIC connection flow control. ClamAV and PostgreSQL do not run an OpenSSL QUIC listener.
statements.author: QC-ControlDana release engineering
statements.evidence: clamd is TCP 3310. PostgreSQL is TCP 5432. Caddyfile protocols are h1 and h2 and Caddy does not use OpenSSL.

statements.impact_statement: PostgreSQL ships libxml2, but this schema and Prisma client never pass document XML to it.
statements.author: QC-ControlDana release engineering
statements.evidence: prisma/schema.prisma has no xml type and the application does not call xmlparse.
